name: EnTA
background: An agentic environment with 31 built-in tools for file operations, code search, bash execution, git operations, web search/fetch, task management, memory, and more. The model learns to plan, reason, and act using these tools in a sandboxed execution environment.

entities.description: Execute shell commands in a sandbox

opts.name: bash
opts.description: Run a command with optional timeout
